GRAPH_COMPLETION.sql_skeleton:
WITH AllMensaChannels AS (
    SELECT 'Myntra' AS channel_name
    FROM zs_observe.myntra_oms
    WHERE group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'LimeRoad' AS channel_name
    FROM zs_observe.limeroad_settlement
    WHERE group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true

    UNION ALL

    SELECT sales.sales_channel AS channel_name -- Using explicit sales_channel from Increff
    FROM zs_observe.increff_sales sales
    WHERE sales.group_level_id = '22' AND sales.is_active = true

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'Amazon' AS channel_name
    FROM zs_observe.amazon_oms
    WHERE group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'Meesho' AS channel_name
    FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales
    WHERE group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'Shopify' AS channel_name
    FROM zs_observe.shopify_oms
    WHERE group_level_id = '22' AND is_active = true
)
SELECT DISTINCT channel_name
FROM AllMensaChannels
ORDER BY channel_name;
